review_queue.normalised_phrase: provided, however, that if any such Person shall fail to perfect, withdraw or otherwise lose the right to appraisal under Section 262 of the DGCL, or if a court of competent jurisdiction shall determine that such Person is not entitled to the relief provided by Section 262 of the DGCL, then such Appraisal Shares shall thereupon be deemed, as of the Effective Time, to have been converted into, and to represent only the right to receive, the Merger Consideration as provided in Section 1.4, without interest thereon and in accordance with the terms of Article II.
